displaced.cause: Per-TU peephole2 emission-order cascade. The body is byte-identical to the floor baseline, and building the baseline revision of src/pump/v90/V90Equalizer.cpp makes it EXACT (28/28). The 11-19 change to enterRRN (emitted immediately before it) moves the victim's return value into %edi, freeing %eax; the peephole2 scratch search then takes the %eax slot and advances the cursor to 51 instead of 3. ~50 re-spellings of enterRRN keep the gain but none restores the victim.
displaced.recovery: Respell enterRRN so it keeps its gain without freeing %eax at its second const0 split, or work the TU in ascending emission order once enterRRN stabilises; remove this entry when the symbol returns to grade 0/1.
